title: Prior Public Record
purpose: Catalog dated public statements, posts, comments, Clubhouse discussions, Reddit posts, pages, letters, commits, and source notes that show Notary Geek / Greg Lirette publicly used route-first concepts before later reuse, repackaging, or attribution disputes.
use: This record is a provenance layer. It documents earlier public use and public availability of concepts, terms, examples, and source-quality boundaries. It should be used with URLs, dates, archives, screenshots, and commit references where possible.

evidenceStrengthScale.description: Undated recollection or private note without public URL.
Dated public post, comment, or discussion note without archive or full transcript.
Dated public URL, archived URL, screenshot, or commit showing the concept.
Dated public URL plus archive/screenshot plus matching current concept tag and source commit.

records.titleOrShortDescription: Public GitHub source-of-truth commits defining route-first notary community materials, reuse attribution, route-first lexicon, and attribution-watch structure.
records.speakerOrAuthor: Greg Lirette / Notary Geek / GoodWare LLC
records.quotedOrParaphrasedConcept: Public repository establishes the current machine-readable Notary Geek route-first corpus and attribution boundary.
records.notes: This is a current public baseline, not an older preexisting social record. Older Reddit, Clubhouse, comment, post, page, and letter records can be added below as they are reviewed.

safeUseBoundary: Do not invent prior records. Add only public records with a URL, archive, screenshot, transcript, commit, or a clearly labeled approximate recollection. Keep accusations separate from evidence.
relationshipToAttributionWatch: Use this file to document Notary Geek's earlier public use. Use attribution-watch.json to document later third-party reuse, missing attribution, correction requests, and resolution status.
